title: Glow Cubes
description: Utilizing the power of bees we can create these bigger glow cubes for even more light. Comes in 17 colours.
body:
![Glowcubes](https://i.imgur.com/8536SDk.png)

# Glow Cubes

**Bright, full-block light sources in every color.**

Glow Cubes adds 17 decorative glowcubes — an undyed base plus all 16 dye colors. Each is a full block that glows at **light level 13** (just shy of glowstone), with a translucent outer shell and a soft inner glow. Clean, colorful lighting *and* building blocks in one.

## Features

- **Every dye color** — white through black, plus an undyed base. 17 in total, in their own creative tab.
- **Bright** — light level 13: enough to keep mobs away and light up your builds.
- **Easy to craft** — surround a glowstone dust with honeycomb for the base, then combine it with any dye to color it. Re-dye anytime.
- **Glass-soft** — breaks fast, full-block shape, no redstone or fuss. Just light.
- **Lightweight** — pure decoration, no performance overhead, works in singleplayer and on servers.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 26.2 *(also available for 26.1)*
- **Loaders:** Fabric and NeoForge
- Fabric builds require **Fabric API**.

## Part of the Hydrofarm family

Glow Cubes started life inside **[Hydrofarm](https://modrinth.com/mod/hydrofarm)** — a water-tech, farming, and automation mod (hydroponic beds, fluid & item pipes, energy, sprinklers, and a lot more). If you want the full toolkit, grab Hydrofarm — it's on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/hydrofarm) and [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hydrofarm).

Run **both** and they fit together seamlessly: Hydrofarm steps aside on its glowcubes so you get a single set — no duplicates, no clutter.
